import random, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker
def big_request(rng, n=60, m=300, k=96, per=16):
    edges=[]
    for _ in range(m):
        t=rng.randrange(n); h=rng.randrange(n)
        while h==t: h=rng.randrange(n)
        edges.append({"tail":t,"head":h,"capacity":rng.randint(1,3)})  # tiny caps -> infeasible
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid,e in enumerate(edges): adj[e["tail"]].append((eid,e["head"]))
    def paths_between(s,t,cnt):
        res=[]
        for _ in range(cnt*12):
            if len(res)>=cnt: break
            cur=s; path=[]; visited={s}; ok=False
            for _ in range(n+1):
                if cur==t: ok=True; break
                outs=[o for o in adj[cur] if o[1] not in visited]
                if not outs: break
                eid,head=rng.choice(outs); path.append(eid); visited.add(head); cur=head
            if ok and cur==t and path and path not in res: res.append(list(path))
        return res
    comms=[]; total=0
    for _ in range(k):
        if total>=768: break
        s=rng.randrange(n); t=rng.randrange(n)
        while t==s: t=rng.randrange(n)
        ps=paths_between(s,t,min(per,768-total))
        if not ps: continue
        parts=len(ps); cuts=sorted(rng.randint(0,16) for _ in range(parts-1))
        prev=[]; last=0
        for cc in cuts+[16]: prev.append(cc-last); last=cc
        comms.append({"source":s,"target":t,"demand":rng.randint(100,1024),"paths":ps,"previous":prev})
        total+=parts
    return {"epoch":rng.randint(0,2**31-1),"node_count":n,"edges":edges,"commodities":comms,"failed_edges":[],"budget":rng.randint(0,98304)}
rng=random.Random(5)
reqs=[big_request(rng) for _ in range(64)]
data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
print("bytes",len(data))
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=800); dt=time.time()-t0
outs=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines()]
from collections import Counter
print("time %.2fs"%dt,"rc",p.returncode,Counter(o.get("status") for o in outs),"nouts",len(outs),"stderr",p.stderr.decode()[:200])
nf=0
for req,o in zip(reqs,outs):
    e,_=checker.check(req,o)
    if e: nf+=1
print("fails",nf)
